[EN] Killian's gained so much control...I really don't know how we're supposed to defeat him now.

And he's brainwashed and cursed so many! I'm walking around constantly worrying that I'm the next person he'll force into his service!
[ES] Killian ha ganado tanto control... Realmente no sé cómo se supone que debemos derrotarlo ahora.

¡Y ha lavado el cerebro y maldecido a tantos! ¡Voy por ahí preocupándome constantemente de que yo sea la próxima persona a la que obligue a unirse a su servicio!
